notes: Adds 20 starter reviews for each of 17 more languages (English, Arabic, Turkish, Russian, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Indonesian, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Polish, Ukrainian) - written specifically for this site and its services (followers/views/members orders), not translations of the Persian set, so /api/reviews?lang=... now has real content in every language the panel already translates into instead of falling back to Persian. If any language's code here doesn't match what's configured on the Languages page, just bulk-update the mismatched rows' 'lang' value in the Reviews section. Requires 'Update database' (seeds ~340 new review rows).
